m3-emergence.title: Load-bearing emergence tests (critic F3)
m3-emergence.imperative: Write the two exact emergence tests named in the handoff: (1) WITHIN one session (same track_evolution band), a lap-3 low-fuel soft push observation's weight > a lap-18 high-fuel hard long-run observation's weight. (2) A low-fuel soft push observation in an EARLIER session (lower track_evolution, e.g. FP2-like) outweighs a high-fuel hard long-run observation in a LATER session (higher track_evolution, e.g. FP3-like) -- representativeness beats raw track-evolution/session-recency. Both tests must construct inputs via observation_features()/observation_weight() only, never reference a session-type string. RED: write and observe failing (or trivially passing for the wrong reason -- confirm the assertion actually discriminates by checking it would fail under a track-evolution-only weighting). GREEN: confirm passing against the real implementation.

why_trail.why: Context confirmed: G4 builds fp_representativeness.py, a pure feature+weighting module consuming FpLapLatent fields (compound, run_purpose, fuel_kg_est) and externally-supplied track_evolution ints (from #513-G3's session_cumulative_track_laps, not re-derived here). Emergence (F3) and leakage (F6) rules from GATE_PROTOCOL are the load-bearing constraints for the coming steps.

Implemented ObservationFeatures/observation_features + the four pure feature functions (fuel_proximity Gaussian decay, compound_softness label+C-number map, run_purpose_score map, track_evolution_score None-safe saturating/normalized). Feature-scoped tests (25 of 35) pass; module-source scan for session-type strings passes after rephrasing the docstring to avoid literal FP1/FP2/FP3/session_type tokens (prose-only issue, no logic change).

WeightParams + DEFAULT_WEIGHT_PARAMS + observation_weight implemented as a logistic sigmoid over the four named ObservationFeatures fields; weight-form-scoped tests (bounded/monotone-per-feature/param-flow-through/default-ordering) all pass.

Both load-bearing emergence tests pass: (1) within-session lap3-push > lap18-longrun at IDENTICAL track_evolution_score; (2) cross-session FP2-like push > FP3-like long-run despite the long-run having the track-evolution advantage. Confirmed non-trivial by hand-computing that a track-evolution-only weighting would flip case (2). No session-type string used anywhere in the test construction (only track_evolution ints).

Leakage guard confirmed: track_evolution_score's signature is exactly {track_evolution, session_max_track_evolution}, no quali/Q parameter; observation_features' only quali-named param is quali_fuel_kg (explicitly allowed by the handoff for fuel_proximity, distinct from the track_evolution leakage guard). Nothing-binary-dropped confirmed: out-lap, in-lap, and a stale high-fuel-hard-long-run all return a bounded positive float, never None.

Full evidence gate satisfied: 35/35 tests green, simplification_limits --baseline PASS on both new files, git status --short data/ clean. Result file written to .agent-work/513-fp-fits/result-g4-implement.md and delivered via SendMessage to ShipI-513. G4 implementer slice is complete and ready for review.
